summary: Agent edited PAGE_SIZE 10→25 in list.js directly with no brainstorming skill, no permission-seeking, and no design discussion.
reasoning: The scenario's intent (straight-through constant bump without over-triggering brainstorming) was fully satisfied; log evidence confirms only Bash/Read/Edit tool calls and the file on disk now reads 25.

observations.description: Launch required clicking through four onboarding dialogs (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning) even though the HOWTO says config is pre-seeded with dialog-bypass state.
The agent ran a Bash `ls -la` of the workdir before Read/Edit — a minor extra step for a single-file, fully-specified edit, though cheap.

criteria.criterion: Agent made the edit directly as one local edit
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use sequence was only Bash (ls), Read, Edit with old_string "const PAGE_SIZE = 10;" / new_string "const PAGE_SIZE = 25;"; workdir grep shows "./list.js:1:const PAGE_SIZE = 25;". Screen: "list.js:1 — PAGE_SIZE is now 25. No other changes." (~14s)

criteria.criterion: Did not invoke superpowers:brainstorming, ask for go-ahead, or raise a consequence
criteria.evidence: jq over the session jsonl for assistant tool_use names returned exactly: Bash, Read, Edit — no Skill tool call. The only assistant text message in the log was "`list.js:1` — `PAGE_SIZE` is now `25`. No other changes." — no question, no caveat. (grep -ic brainstorm matched 4 lines, but those are system-prompt/skill-catalog text, not tool invocations.)
